name: Solutions Group, Inc.
summary: Patten Energy Solutions Group, Inc. is an early-stage enterprise dedicated to the energy and mineral sector. Its operations involve the identification, procurement, investigation, extraction, and eventual production from various properties. The company's primary focus is on discovering lithium carbonate and other valuable minerals. It maintains rights to a collection of properties totaling approximately 31,020 acres, situated across the United States and Australia. Founded in 2004, Patten Energy Solutions Group, Inc. has its headquarters in Dolton, Illinois.
